cue_card.prompt: Describe a book that you have read more than once.
bullets: explain why you decided to read it again

part3.question: Why do some people prefer to re-read a familiar book rather than start a new one?
Do you think e-books will replace printed books in the coming decades?
How could schools encourage students to read for pleasure rather than for exams?

fallback_questions: Is it better to know a few books very well or to read many books quickly?
What kinds of books do people in your country buy most often?
Should libraries keep old books even when nobody borrows them?
